honors.title: 2018 Winner of Fishhackathon in San Francisco
honors.description: For every $100 we spend to buy salmon, the returning to the fishermen in the 3rd world is less than a dollar. Usually, those fishermen do not have smartphones and do not know how to reach out to the fair market values of the fishes that they are selling in daily life. Our team Finnder proposed a simple, but very practical SMS-based application for those fishermen who have feature phones/flip phones. The application provides features for fishermen to send messages to buy/sell fishes to the app and to store those records in a database. Then, the application will calculate mean/median/minimum/maximum/standard deviation metrics to formulate fair market values of fishes out of the collected data. By doing so, fishermen who use Finnder can get an idea of fair market values of their fishes and build strategies to increase the returning from their daily labor. As a winner of the hackathon, the team Finnder received $5,000 credits for AWS.
honors.issuer: Issued by Fishhackathon - Hacker Nest · Feb 2018
